title: E0031: Division by Zero
plain_english: Reports division operations where the divisor can be zero.
why_matters: Division by zero causes runtime errors. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to find feasible paths where a divisor can be zero and provide a solver-backed counterexample. This rule is part of the verification family E0031-E0043. Proofs are relative to the modeled subset, configured checks, and project interprocedural summaries. A clean result means no violation was found in that model; it does not prove every possible PHP execution is safe.
bad_example:
<?php
function average(int $total, int $count): float
{
    return $total / $count; // $count can be 0
}
good_example:
<?php
function average(int $total, int $count): float
{
    if ($count === 0) {
        return 0.0;
    }

    return $total / $count;
}
